result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues including a loading spinner stuck over an image, a cut-off card at the screen edge, and a category tab partially hidden.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar image shows a circular loading spinner overlay that appears stuck, suggesting the image failed to load or is stuck loading
issues.suggestion: Ensure image assets load properly and remove/hide the spinner once content is loaded; add a fallback image or retry mechanism

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding/margin or a horizontal scroll indicator so users know more content is available

issues.description: The 'Healthy' category filter chip is cut off at the right edge, and there appears to be a partially visible chip beyond it
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient indicator or ensure consistent padding so users understand the category list is scrollable

issues.description: Inconsistent heart/favorite icon styling - white heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar vs black background heart icon on the pizza promo below
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon button background and color across all cards for visual consistency

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated due to card cutoff, making it hard to read the full name
issues.suggestion: Ensure card width accommodates full text or apply text truncation with ellipsis intentionally and consistently
